Lemma
[normalized evolution of homogeneous quantities] Source: cao-zhu 1. Lemma 5.1.1\group Normalized Ricci Flow on Surfaces

Suppose $P$ satisfies \[ \frac{\partial P}{\partial t}=\Delta P+Q \] for the unnormalized Ricci flow, and $P$ has degree $k$. Then $Q$ has degree $k-1$, and for the normalized Ricci flow, \[ \frac{\partial \tilde{P}}{\partial \tilde{t}}=\tilde{\Delta } \tilde{P}+\tilde{Q}+\frac{2}{n}k\tilde{r}\tilde{P}. \]
